top_signals.title: Zero-click spyware infecting devices through online ads, researchers say
top_signals.summary: Powerful zero-click spyware is infected devices worldwide through targeted ads, new research shows — an alarming development in the spread of surveillance technology.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Why Is India Overhauling Its New Closing Auction System: Q&A
top_signals.summary: India’s markets regulator has overhauled key parts of its recently introduced closing-auction framework after its early rollout was marked by thin liquidity, sharp price swings and concerns over manipulation.

top_signals.title: U.S. holds more secret talks with Myanmar’s military-backed rulers in Tokyo, sources say
top_signals.summary: It was their second meeting in a month as Washington steps up reengagement with the generals it shunned after their 2021 coup.

top_signals.title: PJM, ERCOT, and SWPP all set peak load records this summer
top_signals.summary: Three regional transmission organizations (RTOs) set records for peak hourly load this past summer, according to data reported on Form EIA-930 and presented in the Hourly Electric Grid Monitor.
